How it works

Order to first session

No consultation and no quote request: every price is on the site, and shipping is free.

  1. 01

    Choose and order

    Every price and spec is on the site, with no name or phone number needed. Financing is available through Bread Pay at checkout, and PEAK saunas may be eligible for HSA/FSA purchase through Redo.

  2. 02

    Free delivery

    It ships in a PeakGuard custom wooden crate. In-stock orders ship within 2–4 business days, and the carrier calls 1–2 days ahead to book a 4-hour window.

  3. 03

    The Mini, Rainier and Shasta use a standard 120V/15A outlet. Then Peak Wellness Club, included free, gives you expert protocols with temperature, duration and timing.

Questions

Before you buy

What does the warranty cover?

PEAK has a 7-year residential warranty. From the date of delivery: heating elements and cabinetry, 7 years; the control system, power supply and red light therapy panels, 3 years; chromotherapy lighting, audio, WiFi/app connectivity and accessories, 1 year.

It covers the original purchaser and requires installation within 6 months of delivery.

How does delivery work?

Shipping is free on every order in the continental US. Saunas ship by freight in a PeakGuard custom wooden crate from Ontario, California. In-stock orders ship within 2–4 business days, and the carrier calls 1–2 days before delivery to schedule a 4-hour window.

Standard delivery is curbside; white-glove or garage delivery is available for an extra fee.

What outlet do I need?

Mini, Rainier and Shasta: a standard 120V/15A outlet, no electrician needed. Fuji and Everest: a dedicated 120V/20A outlet (a standard 15A outlet is not enough). Denali and Matterhorn: a 240V outlet. Patagonia: a dedicated 240V/20A outdoor-rated circuit; Kilimanjaro and El Capitan: a dedicated 240V/30A outdoor-rated circuit, each installed by an electrician.

Can I pay over time?

Financing is available through Bread Pay at checkout. PEAK saunas may also be eligible for HSA/FSA purchase through Redo.

What comes after the sauna arrives?

Peak Wellness Club is included free with every PEAK sauna: protocols from athletes and other experts with the temperature, duration, timing and breathwork for each, a streak leaderboard, and a private owner community. You also get lifetime U.S.-based support.
